label: No pure determination requires the lack of pure determinations
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every pure determination d and every set S of pure determinations, d does not require the lack of S. It covers a single excluded determination and a joint lack alike. Its rationale is DEF-PURE-PERFECTION: requiring the lack of a positive actuality would be a limitation of the requirer. It is the requirement-form counterpart of joint compossibility, not independent of it: under member grounding and pure admissibility, joint compossibility gives it for every finite set (finiteConverse).
